additional_info.body:
Hello Liz, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked remotely and found that the Router is not communicating with the charger:
I see that you already performed some kind of troubleshooting:
Hard Reboot of the charger
Checked ethernet cabling to the router - al ok
Tried different ports on network switch - no traffic coming from Router
Cannot get Router configure remotely via SCB
The only possibility I see here is that the Router is not getting the power supply or it's indeed faulty and not working.
Do you need a field service engineer to go to the charger or do you have a 3rd party that can provide support? After you give me your feedback, I will prepare a guide for the next steps to be taken.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0473481-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R5 313057100007]  OCPP Router offline CRM:02888000559
additional_info.body:
Good day Liz,
Thanks for the update.
Understanding this is an intermittent issue, as you suggested it would be best to keep this charger in review.
As the charger is under warranty, if you would like to claim the router and time sent for the repair, we would require a technical service report, detailing what tasks were undertaken.
Also ensuring that no failover was setup on the charger during the initial commissioning, as this could also result in connection loses, which would be restored after power cycles and could indicate why the global team saw no SIM card activity.
Thanks and have a good day.
With Kind regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
